limitations: This audit does not reconstruct platform execution logs, hidden model reasoning, randomization, model parameters or actual isolation from report files. Parent-issued helper receipts plus substantive returned artifacts support recorded lineage, not independent platform attestation.
No production adoption or external efficacy is within this hypothetical research objective. The absence of those results is an explicit claim ceiling, not a failed research step.
Small authored case sets with one native output per arm/cell support bounded selection observations; ties do not prove equivalence or ineffectiveness.
S05 is a conceptual family tournament supplemented by actual selection exercises and capacity models. It is not an empirical trial of three implemented organizational interventions.
Remaining effect/cost/transfer uncertainties are retained as future adoption residue; labels do not prove an operator has accepted future capacity.
